trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Rodolfo: Back and forth along this ledge, all day long. Nobody gets up the hill without going through me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Rodolfo: Up you go, then. Mind the drop.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Ranger Ashlee: Careful where you tread! These woods belong to the Pokémon. We're only passing through.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Ranger Ashlee: You fight hard and you fight fair. The woods can spare you a path.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Bird Keeper Audrey: The sea wind climbs these cliffs and my birds ride it for hours. Come and see how high!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Bird Keeper Audrey: Brought down to earth. It's a long way to fall.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Daisy: My Pokémon are slow. So slow! But they've already thought of everything you're about to do.
Dragon Tamer Geoffrey: Dragons don't obey just anybody. Mine obey me! Mostly!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Dragon Tamer Geoffrey: Mostly wasn't enough today.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Deanna: The Survival Area is just over the rise. Let's find out whether you'd survive it!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Deanna: You'll do. Tell them Deanna sent you.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Ranger Dwayne: I walk this whole wood twice a day, looking after every Pokémon in it. You're next on my round!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Ranger Dwayne: Nothing wrong with your team. I'll make a note of it.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Quinn: I've lost to everybody in the Battle Zone once. I don't lose to anybody twice. You're new, aren't you?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Quinn: That's once. Come back and try me again.
